text.formatted: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
text.plain: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

text.formatted: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
text.plain: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

text.formatted: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
text.plain: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. _Hit:_ 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 9 Constitution saving throw or take 2 (1d4) poison damage.
text.plain: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 9 Constitution saving throw or take 2 (1d4) poison damage.
